candidate.definition_en: An optical instrument used to make distant objects appear nearer.
candidate.explanation_ar: جهاز بيقرب البعيد، بنستخدمه عشان نشوف النجوم والكواكب في السما.

senses.definition_en: An optical instrument used to make distant objects appear nearer.
senses.explanation_ar: جهاز بيقرب البعيد، بنستخدمه عشان نشوف النجوم والكواكب في السما.
examples: We looked at the stars through a telescope.
He has a small telescope in his room.
The invention of the telescope changed our view of the universe.
